confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors come from aggregated UK and Edinburgh cost-of-living and pub-price sources, which broadly agree, though some are undated. Cocktail and wine anchors rest on thin, mixed sources and a beer-relative judgement, so they are lower confidence. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July festival-season window and were not checked against live listings. The FX value (0.6955, 15 Oct 2026) was taken from search-result excerpts attributed to the RBA, not read directly from rba.gov.au. GBP-denominated estimates were converted at about 1.35 USD per GBP, based on a September 2026 quote.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed for food and drink, since Edinburgh-specific and UK-wide price guides were available. The wine glass is set relative to beer (roughly 1.35 times a pint) because direct Edinburgh restaurant wine-by-the-glass data was weak. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Edinburgh's high summer demand, especially during the August festivals, relative to other UK capital-city hotel markets.
